bar.page_text:
Lumen Ledger
Features
Pricing
Help
Know where your household money goes

Lumen Ledger sorts your bills into 12 clear groups. It is trusted by 40,000 households.

Start a free ledger
What it does for you
Sorts every bill

Comprehensive categorization functionality automatically differentiates recurring residential expenditures, discretionary entertainment purchases and miscellaneous administrative obligations, consequently facilitating considerably more informed household financial decision-making throughout subsequent accounting periods.

Shows each month

See what you spent this month next to last month. Big changes stand out, and you can read the short guide to learn more.

Plain numbers, no jargon

Setup takes about 5 minutes. Plans cost $4 a month when the 30-day free trial ends. You can stop at any time, and you keep your ledger for as long as you want it.

Fictional demo: no real accounts or payments.

Questions? Write to help@example.com
